tools.name: ask_astranl
tools.description: Turn a real-world task or question into a routing decision: whether AstraNL can help, which one tool to call, what to supply, what can and cannot be verified. No commitment, nothing created, no key. Also answers whether a physical task is feasible in the Netherlands.

tools.name: check_counterparty_nl
tools.description: Check a Dutch or EU counterparty against official sources before your own next step, such as onboarding a supplier, paying an invoice or signing an order. Give the KvK number, the company name and the EU VAT number as your document states them. Returns verdicts, not register data: whether the KvK nu

tools.name: record_counterparty_check
tools.description: Make a result of check_counterparty_nl verifiable by others: records its digest in the AstraNL signed public log and returns a reference that a colleague, approver or auditor can check later with verify_astranl, without trusting AstraNL. Works only for a check AstraNL produced in the last 48 hours.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Ask AstraNL to find and coordinate a verified executor for a physical task in the Netherlands. Returns an ingress receipt at once and a case once planning found a path; the client pays the executor directly; AstraNL holds no money. A step can stand on confirmed references supplied in based_on. tools.name: check_task

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Machine-checkable evidence for an AstraNL task, action or receipt: the signed log events that mention it, each verified live, with a proof block stating what is verified, what is not, validity, status, limitations and next actions.

tools.name: verify_astranl
tools.description: Read receipts confirm which read was served when and through which door, with current or expired status and optional answer_sha256 match; content is not stored and is not a quote, price guarantee or proof of delivery. Verify supported AstraNL references without a key: ASTRA-A/R/C, alk_, att_/atr_ an

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "streamable?profile=protocol" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nl_municipal_build_rules, check_material · Private data: check_counterparty_nl, record_counterparty_check, verify_astranl, ground_astranl, check_material, commitment_attest · Public sink: commitment_attest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nl_municipal_build_rules, check_material · Private data: check_counterparty_nl, record_counterparty_check, verify_astranl, ground_astranl, check_material, commitment_attest · Public sink: commitment_attest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
